why: The implementing decree itself: defines the 17-digit NIN, prints it on the card, and Art.2 makes the biometric CNI serve as the voter card - the primary instrument of the identity credential being consumed by another state system

In-window: the e-Senegal single-window portal (live 2026-03-24) authenticates users on the NIN from the biometric CNI - a distinct, completed step putting the national ID to work as the login key of a multi-service government portal

The ministry system documentation itself: states nationwide deployment of the IEN unique national education identifier and describes SIMEN as an interconnected suite - the standing state of education-system data exchange
In-window completed step: PLANET 3 launched 2025-10-03 and declared the national norm, replacing a fragmented system with per-actor interfaces and real-time data

Most recent authoritative publication of the national birth-registration series: ANSD/ICF EDS-Continue 2023 Tableau 2.10 gives 81.4% of under-fives registered at the civil registry, and the SDG table repeats it as indicator 16.9.1
In-window: a newly published 2025 coverage measurement (110,148 of 186,744 children, 58.98%) reported at the signature of an ANEC-ANPECTP convention on audiences foraines and enrolment campaigns

Distinct in-window event: ANEC states 20m acts loaded into the national civil register and NEKKAL deployed in 400 centres, and rules NEKKAL the only government-recognised tool, calling on mayors to abandon unauthorised software

The institution itself: the Interior Ministry states the DAF mandate under decret 77-1007, its single national processing centre, its own study and development of every ministry file application, its procurement competence, and the full list of credentials it produces

In-window completed step with the agency naming its own maintenance deficits: NEKKAL closed after 42 months having consolidated the national biometric identity file, with connectivity and staff training named as unresolved

The service itself: the state digital operator states it runs an IGC/PKI under loi 2008-08 and decret 2008-720, lists the certificate lifecycle it operates and names authentification des personnes and des donnees among its services

In-window: the first citizen-facing government authentication in production, the e-Senegal portal keyed on the NIN of the biometric CNI. One file, two selections - also the baseline-brief progress item for dpi.exchange--use-of-digital-id-in-other-systems

The most technically specific account of the identity file actually being consumed: it analyses the existing biometric files, the interconnections between them and the NIN problem, and documents CMU beneficiary authentication against the DAF card and the passport service gateway to the DAF CNI database

In-window enforced consumption: the final phase of the ARTP national SIM identification campaign, run with DAF technical support, with unidentified lines suspended in March and terminated from 29 September 2025
Distinct in-window event: the IPRES pension system makes the ECOWAS national identity card the entry condition of its Maa ngi nii digital proof-of-life platform, live 1 July 2026

In-window supervisory act with named addressees and dates: the BCEAO resets PI-SPI connection deadlines to 30 September 2026 for banks, EME and payment institutions and 30 June 2027 for microfinance, and publishes participation figures as at 24 June 2026

Distinct in-window event held in Dakar: the BCEAO convenes an international conference and governors round table on crypto-assets, stating regulatory, supervisory and monetary-sovereignty positions - the central bank putting a new asset class on its own governance agenda

The system itself: the Treasury directorate launched SenTresor on 2 June 2025 to digitise state payments of salaries, allowances, social aid, pensions and scholarships, published before the window opens
In-window completed step: the Caisse de Securite Sociale opens payment of social benefits into Wave accounts, a named public body naming a named e-money operator

Distinct in-window government decision: the council records the RNU extended to 996,194 households and fixes the start of the pilot to digitise bourses de securite familiale payments before the end of 2026

The customs administration stating its own system: GAINDE 2000 with ORBUS 2000 integrated allows the electronic payment of duties and taxes, and no goods may be removed without payment - the operative B2G payment rail described by the body that runs it

In-window: the ministry states the Treasury e-paiement platform consolidated so users pay taxes, fines and administrative fees by phone in one system, and names the DGID-Douanes interconnection as a first e-Jokko use case

Regional register binding Senegal, giving the standing state of who may issue e-money there: 11 authorised initiatives, three licensed issuers named, eight banks issuing through partners, and the union series back to 2021
In-window and Senegal-specific: the 13 Senegalese participants authorised to open PI-SPI instant interoperable payment services at the 30 September 2025 launch, the largest count in the union
Distinct in-window event on the P2G leg: the DGID opens tax, duty and fee payment through the Orange MAX IT app under the Jubaanti Koom recovery plan

The operative regional instrument on external financial relations binding Senegal, and it names its own predecessor: Article 35 abrogates Reglement 09/2010, so the commonly cited 2010 text is no longer the rule
In-window regulatory act: an application note under article 31 of Reglement 06/2024 fixing how external payments by foreign nationals resident in the Union are treated
Distinct in-window event: a newly published BCEAO-sourced figure for the cross-border flow, FCFA 2,211bn in 2024 against 1,600bn in 2023, about 12 per cent of GDP

The operative recourse rule binding e-money institutions in Senegal: mandatory internal complaints arrangement, customer information, registration and receipt, a one-month maximum reply and free handling
In-window measured output of the national recourse mechanism: OQSF handled 475 disputed files in 2025 against 379 in 2024, with the grounds of complaint broken out

In-window gazette record of Loi n 2025-17 amending the Code general des Impots, adopted 27 September 2025, the candidate vehicle for the mobile-money transfer levy the SEN ledger still records as unadopted
